title: Enable Mintlify partial authentication for audience separation
description: Provider activation blocker with final non-Enterprise model. Required provider steps: (1) Mintlify Dashboard -> Authentication: set site visibility to Private with Authenticated partial auth enabled. (2) Ensure all intended reviewers are Mintlify organization members. (3) Redeploy the site after the provider auth change. (4) Run deployed/provider acceptance: anonymous public routes return 200, restricted routes return redirect/auth/403/404 (never 200), authenticated organization members can access restricted review pages, and public llms.txt/llms-full/MCP/search surfaces contain only public content. Preview-wide organization auth/password can be defense in depth but does not replace anonymous-public acceptance smoke.

title: Implement internal/public Mintlify audience separation
description: Implement the Mintlify partial-auth audience boundary in this repository with explicit public markers, organization-member restricted review route metadata, deterministic static gate, local runtime E2E smoke, CI wiring, workflow documentation, and provider activation blocker.
close_reason: Repository implementation complete; provider activation remains blocked separately.
